package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lesson"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type lessonMaterialsResponse struct {
	Lesson          map[string]any                   `json:"lesson"`
	Stack           string                           `json:"stack,omitempty"`
	Examples        []domain.LessonExample           `json:"examples"`
	Tasks           []taskResponse                   `json:"tasks"`
	RelatedLessons  []relatedLessonMaterialResponse  `json:"related_lessons"`
	RelatedExamples []relatedExampleMaterialResponse `json:"related_examples"`
}

type relatedLessonMaterialResponse struct {
	Relation      domain.LessonRelation  `json:"relation"`
	AccessContext relationAccessContext  `json:"access_context"`
	Lesson        map[string]any         `json:"lesson"`
	Examples      []domain.LessonExample `json:"examples"`
	Tasks         []taskResponse         `json:"tasks"`
}

type relatedExampleMaterialResponse struct {
	Relation      domain.LessonExampleRelation `json:"relation"`
	AccessContext relationAccessContext        `json:"access_context"`
	Example       domain.LessonExample         `json:"example"`
}

type relationAccessContext struct {
	Kind       string `json:"kind"`
	RelationID string `json:"relation_id"`
}

// Materials returns the current Lesson content and its authored related materials.
func (h LessonHandler) Materials(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	result, err := h.MaterialsUC.Handle(
		r.Context(),
		chi.URLParam(r, "lessonID"),
		r.URL.Query().Get("stack"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		var accessErr *domain.LessonReadAccessError
		switch {
		case errors.As(err, &accessErr):
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		default:
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}

	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(buildLessonMaterialsResponse(result))
}

func buildLessonMaterialsResponse(result *lesson.LessonMaterials) lessonMaterialsResponse {
	relatedLessons := make([]relatedLessonMaterialResponse, 0, len(result.RelatedLessons))
	for _, item := range result.RelatedLessons {
		relatedLessons = append(relatedLessons, relatedLessonMaterialResponse{
			Relation:      item.Relation,
			AccessContext: relationAccessContext{Kind: "lesson_relation", RelationID: item.Relation.ID},
			Lesson:        item.Lesson,
			Examples:      nonNilExamples(item.Examples),
			Tasks:         lessonMaterialTaskResponses(item.Tasks),
		})
	}
	relatedExamples := make([]relatedExampleMaterialResponse, 0, len(result.RelatedExamples))
	for _, item := range result.RelatedExamples {
		relatedExamples = append(relatedExamples, relatedExampleMaterialResponse{
			Relation:      item.Relation,
			AccessContext: relationAccessContext{Kind: "example_relation", RelationID: item.Relation.ID},
			Example:       item.Example,
		})
	}
	return lessonMaterialsResponse{
		Lesson:          result.Lesson,
		Stack:           result.Stack,
		Examples:        nonNilExamples(result.Examples),
		Tasks:           lessonMaterialTaskResponses(result.Tasks),
		RelatedLessons:  relatedLessons,
		RelatedExamples: relatedExamples,
	}
}

func lessonMaterialTaskResponses(items []lesson.LessonMaterialTask) []taskResponse {
	result := make([]taskResponse, 0, len(items))
	for index := range items {
		result = append(result, buildTaskResponse(&items[index].Task, items[index].Tests, nil, false, false, nil))
	}
	return result
}

func nonNilExamples(items []domain.LessonExample) []domain.LessonExample {
	if items == nil {
		return make([]domain.LessonExample, 0)
	}
	return items
}
